supervisor_summary: The round-2 forecasts converged: fair values $421-441 (mean $432), P(>= spot in 12m) ~0.50, and all round-1 RMT errors fixed. The split-off retires ~8.5M shares for ~$0.5 of EPS dilution, and the 8-vs-9M dispute is worth only ~$1/share. The main remaining bias is that three agents cut the multiple for a 5.24% 10-year the stock already absorbed (ETN +8% while the 10-year rose 49bp in September). Correcting it gives a fair value of ~$437 and P(>=432) of ~0.51. This is a fairly priced, high-beta AI-power compounder with event risk in the next five weeks: the Oct 27-28 FOMC, hyperscaler capex prints, and Q3 on ~Nov 3 (~25% chance it lands on Oct 30).
key_drivers: Data-center demand durability into 2027-28: EA rolling orders +41%, backlog +33% (EG +103% with Boyd); Laguna DC orders +85%, pipeline +130%. Peer and industry reads are supportive (NEMA EBCI 65.8 in Aug; MV switchgear lead times 2-4x normal).

Horizon multiple: ~28.5x NTM today, already priced against a 5.24% 10-year. The base case compresses it to ~26x as NTM EPS growth slows from ~16% to ~13%. Further unexpected rate rises are the main left-tail risk to the multiple.
Mobility/Dana split-off (Q1 2027): ~8.5M shares retired, $1.1B to debt, ~$0.5 (~3%) EPS dilution, no base-case price drop. Pro-forma NTM EPS at the horizon is ~$16.8.
Margin execution: Q3 needs a ~170bp step-up to 24.6-25.0%. Management said at Laguna it is tracking the high end.
Leverage ~$19.9B net debt, no 2026 buybacks, deleveraging toward ~$17-18B by Sep 2027.
